topic: Review: commit 79f5dacc52 on origin/main (diff 49cfd5c89f..79f5dacc52), merged in c5b3bd9355: a new read-only /doctor:sk-code command with one target, setup. sk-code-setup-check.cjs runs eight legs from the repository root (provisioning precheck via require.resolve of @spec-kit/shared, parent-skill-check on sk-code, ci-skill-root-metadata, compiled-route-guard --json, compiled-route-sync --check, the sk-code drift guards, ci-skill-derived-freshness --format json, and a compiled-route probe that passes only on a parsed action route), prints one repair line per failing leg, skips the two provision-dependent legs when the precheck fails, and writes nothing; a nine-case node:test suite drives it against stub roots; the command doc, its _routes.yaml route (mutating read-only), workflow YAML and presentation; the command-contract router list; index rows and one reference line each in the root README, the sk-code README and SKILL.md; regenerated runtime mirrors
